rules: Wrap hands every session; 14-16 oz bag gloves.
Rounds start at 2 min work / 1 min rest.
Log date, RPE hit, weights, anything that felt off.

standard_warmup.name: Standard warm-up
items: Rower: 3 x 2 min, 30 sec rest. Easy, moderate, a little brisker. 20-24 strokes/min, damper 3-5.
Dynamic mobility (3-4 min): arm circles 10 each direction, leg swings 10 per leg, hip circles 10 each way, world's greatest stretch 3 per side, bodyweight squats 10, band pull-aparts 15.
Stance bounce: 90 sec, light on the balls of the feet, shifting forward, back, side to side.
Shadowbox: 2 x 2 min at 50%. Stance, hands up, chin down, breathe out on every punch.
standard_warmup.notes: Saturdays only: add 2-3 min jump rope right after the rower.

items: Brisk walk 5 min.
Dynamic mobility from the standard warm-up.

blocks.name: Zone 2 cardio
items: Incline treadmill walk, easy jog, bike, or rower at a pace where you can talk in full sentences.

blocks.name: Shadow flow
items: Review what you drilled this week. Slow and clean. Picture an opponent.
first_session_version: R1: stance and step-drag footwork, no punches
R4: easy 1-2s with a step in and out

core: Side plank: 2 x 20 sec per side

items: Full-body mobility flow: hip flexors, hamstrings, T-spine (open book), shoulders (cross-body), wrists, calves. 30-45 sec each.

blocks.name: Footwork drills
items: Step-drag in 4 directions: 4 x 1 min, 30 sec rest. Foot closest to the direction moves first; never cross or bring feet together.
Pivot drill: 2 x 1 min.
In-and-out drill: 3 x 30 sec.

blocks.name: Technical shadowboxing
items: R1: jab only (single, double, jab while stepping forward)
R2: cross, then the 1-2
R3: 1-2, then step back out of range
R4: freestyle 1, 2, and 1-1-2 with footwork

blocks.name: Technical heavy bag
items: R1: jabs while circling the bag
R3: 1-2-3 (lead hook short, elbow at shoulder height)
R5: freestyle, moving after every combo

blocks.name: Speed bag intro
items: Fists at eye level, rhythm over power.

core: Side plank: 2 x 20 sec per side

items: 3 min easy walk.
Stretch 30-45 sec each: chest (doorway), lats, hip flexors, hamstrings, calves.
1 min slow breathing: 4 in, 6 out.

tuesday.note: For recovering, not training. If you finish sweaty, you did too much.
items: Easy walk: 15-20 min, relaxed pace.
Foam roll: 30-60 sec each on quads, outer thigh, glutes, upper back, lats, calves.
Mobility: 90/90 hip switches (6 per side), cat-cow (10), thoracic open books (6 per side), wrist circles and forearm stretches.
Light shadowboxing: 3 x 2 min at 30%. Slow and smooth.
Breathing: 3-5 min slow nasal breathing with a long exhale.
tuesday.emphasis: Extra time on shoulders and upper back.

wednesday.warmup_extra: 1 round on the bag at 50% to find range.

blocks.name: Power rounds
items: One combo at 80-85%, reset, breathe, repeat.
R1: hard 1-2
R2: cross only, turning the rear hip
R5: freestyle power combos, moving between them

blocks.name: Bag intervals
items: Straight punches as fast as possible, then active rest.

blocks.name: Bag + bodyweight circuit
items: 45 sec bag combos
15 bodyweight squats
8-10 push-ups (beginner: hands on bench; advanced: clap or deficit)
20 mountain climbers

core: Cable Pallof press: 3 x 10 per side
Hanging knee raise: 3 x 8 (beginner: lying leg raise)

items: 5 min easy bike.
Stretch shoulders, forearms and wrists, thoracic rotation, hips.

wednesday.safety: If a wrist hurts on impact, drop to 60% and check you're landing on the first two knuckles with a straight wrist. Persistent pain: stop and get it checked.

items: 5 min easy rower or bike
Dynamic mobility from the standard warm-up
1-2 light ramp-up sets before the first lift

blocks.name: Power
items: Med ball rotational wall throw: 3 x 5 per side
Box jump: 3 x 5, step down (beginner: squat jump onto low box or no box)

blocks.name: Strength
items: A. Trap bar deadlift: 3 x 8, 2 min rest (beginner: KB deadlift 3 x 10; advanced: 4 x 5 heavier)
B1. Goblet squat 3 x 10 / B2. Single-arm DB row 3 x 10 per side, 90 sec rest after each pair
C1. DB split squat 3 x 8 per side / C2. Half-kneeling landmine press 3 x 8 per side, 90 sec rest after each pair

blocks.name: Metabolic finisher
items: Min 1: kettlebell swings x 12
Min 2: rower x 10 cal (beginner 8, advanced 14)
Min 3: med ball slams x 10
blocks.note: Beginner option: 30 sec work, rest remainder of each minute.

core: Ab wheel rollout: 3 x 8 (beginner: from knees, short range; advanced: standing)
Side plank: 2 x 30 sec per side

items: Easy walk or bike, stretch hips, hamstrings, quads, lats.
2 min box breathing: 4 in, hold 4, out 4, hold 4.

friday.note: For recovering, not training. If you finish sweaty, you did too much.
items: Easy walk: 15-20 min, relaxed pace.
Foam roll: 30-60 sec each on quads, outer thigh, glutes, upper back, lats, calves.
Mobility: 90/90 hip switches (6 per side), cat-cow (10), thoracic open books (6 per side), wrist circles and forearm stretches.
Light shadowboxing: 3 x 2 min at 30%. Slow and smooth.
Breathing: 3-5 min slow nasal breathing with a long exhale.
friday.emphasis: Extra time on legs and hips.

saturday.warmup_extra: 2-3 min jump rope after the rower.

blocks.name: Double-end bag
items: R1: jab only, learn the timing
R3: jab, then slip the return
R4: freestyle with movement

blocks.name: Speed bag
items: Rhythm, not power.

blocks.name: Footwork & angles
items: Agility ladder: 6 passes
Lateral shuffle between cones 3 m apart: 4 x 20 sec, 40 sec rest
Angle-out shadow drill: 3 x 2 min. 1-2, then pivot or step off to the side.

blocks.name: Light plyos
items: Pogo hops: 3 x 20
Lateral skater bounds: 3 x 6 per side, land soft

core: Hollow hold: 3 x 20 sec (beginner: bent-knee tuck)
Bird dog: 2 x 8 per side, slow

items: 3 min walk, stretch calves, hip flexors, glutes, shoulders.

schedule_weeks_1_2.note: Check-in with log after this session

progression.change: Add 1 round to each bag and shadow block.
Move to 3-minute rounds; add load to lifts.
Deload: cut volume by about a third, same schedule.

early_3min_test: Move to 3-min rounds early only if hands stay up, punches snap, and feet keep moving at the bell of every round, including the last one on heavy bag day.
nutrition_notes: Modest calorie deficit, protein at every meal, 7-9 hours sleep, walk on off days. Track weekly average weight, not daily.

blocks.name: Weeks 1-2: Foundations
blocks.check_in: Export your log and check in with Coach V for Block 2.

block_rules: Sessions come only from the active block's days file. Never modify sessions automatically.
After the last block ends: keep showing the last block's sessions, and show a persistent banner with that block's check_in message.
The progression list is coaching guidance to display, not rules to apply.
New blocks arrive as an update bundle (JSON) imported in-app. Validate every exercise and footwork reference before accepting it.
